quests.title: Viridian Forest: the Honey tree (weekday Bug Pokémon)

wild.method: Bug-Catching Contest: Set 1: Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays
notes: During the Bug-Catching Contest, the wild Pokémon come from the contest sets listed below, not from the park's normal table.

acquisitions.conditions: Use one Honey on the shining Honey tree on Tuesday. Repeatable with more Honey; the DS clock determines the weekday.
